{{Quote|Where are you going, Master?"<br />"For a drink.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''Outlander Club''', also referred to as the '''Outlander Nightclub''' or the '''Outlander''', was a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located along [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]] in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The club, owned by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Volven Roxe]], originally catered to the connoisseurs of the card game "[[Outlander (game)/Legends|Outlander]]."

==Description==
===A noted nightclub===
[[File:OutlanderClub_CL.jpg|thumb|right|400px|The Outlander Club was located in the Uscru Entertainment District.]]
The Outlander Club, also known as the Outlander Nightclub<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> or just the Outlander<ref name="CoruscantCore" /> was a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE" /> located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]]'s [[Vos Gesal Street/Legends|Vos Gesal Street]].<ref name="OC">{{DB|location|outlandersclub|Outlander Club}}</ref> The club had a good location,<ref name="FF44" /> and it was situated next to the [[Snapping Septoid/Legends|Snapping Septoid]].<ref name="OC" /> The proprietors of the club were a secretive band of [[Columi/Legends|Columi]], though it was truly owned by local [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Volven Roxe]].<ref name="CoruscantCore">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> It was once a small and stylish establishment that catered to the high-class connoisseurs of the complex and fashionable<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> gambling<ref name="CSWE" /> game "[[Outlander (game)/Legends|Outlander]]."<ref name="CL" /> 

Under the management of the [[Baath brothers/Legends|Baath brothers]], the club became a notorious meeting place for Coruscant's criminal networks and rapidly expanded to accommodate the latest gaming trends.<ref name="CL" /> The club eschewed dignity for dazzle and welcomed everyone's credits and trafficked high-risk vice.<ref name="CoruscantCore" /> Being tucked away in a less developed area of the Uscru District, which was rarely patrolled by law enforcement crews, the club was not secret of its policy to accept bets on just about every game in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The club even accepted the popular [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]], which betting on was highly illegal.<ref name="CL" />

===Features of the Outlander===
At the brightly lit, wide main entrance<ref name="FF44" /> of the Outlander Club was the familiar glowing "welcoming arms" logo of the club<ref name="CL" /> and the club's name. Beside the name was a shifting [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] that showed the hostesses working at the club and welcomed passers-by in the main [[Language/Legends|languages]] of the patrons.<ref name="FF44" /> To the right of the entrance, an elevated transporter carriage connected the Outlander with a public [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] bus station.<ref name="CL" /> The inside of the club, where the floor areas were in a spacious and circular layout, was loosely defined by the walls sweeping curves, and occasionally a step up or down. The club's side walls were connected to the [[Refresher/Legends|refreshers]] on the upper level and the private function suites by grav-lifts, or the less popular but well-lit stairs.<ref name="FF44" />

The large central bar<ref name="FF44" /> was surrounded by five one or two-person [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]], one of which connected the story to a high-security office were winnings were paid.<ref name="CL" /> The bar, which contained a central liquid-processing unit, included a [[Polyquaternium-7 multicarbonator|polyquarternium-7 multicarbonator]]<ref name="TVD" /> and a hose that was used to pour drinks.<ref name="AOTCComic">[[Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones 1|''Star Wars: Episode II — Attack of the Clones'' 1]]</ref> Stocked there was [[Aludium pu-36]], [[Insecticide/Legends|insecticide]],<ref name="TVD" /> and the "[[starshine special]]" additive.<ref name="TVD" /> Near the bar was a<ref name="CL" /> gambling lounge<ref name="FF96" /> with a central<ref name="CL" /> betting kiosk<ref name="CL" /> and three huge<ref name="FF44" /> viewscreens that displayed<ref name="CL" /> the latest sports<ref name="FF96" /> and sport events<ref name="CL" /> live<ref name="FF44" /> from around the galaxy, such as<ref name="CL" /> illegal<ref name="CoruscantCore" /> [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], [[Nuna-ball/Legends|nuna-ball]], and [[odupiendo racing]]. The gamescreens gave the patrons the opportunity for highly addictive and inexpensive gambling. Dotted throughout the floor were small tables,<ref name="CL" /> [[Drinks chiller|drinks chillers]],<ref name="TVD" /> smaller bars,<ref name="FF44" /> and a gambling table.<ref name="Head-Games">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/11/imageattack20021106.html|series=Image Attack|text=Head-Games}}</ref> 

Above the bar was a curving walkway accessible from the back of the turbolifts. The walkway led to a<ref name="CL" /> private gambling room<ref name="Jhabacc">{{CSWECite|II|161|jhabacc}}</ref> where favored guests placed a high-stakes form of the game [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] known as [[Jhabacc/Legends|Jhabacc]]. The private bar and gambling table in the room was reserved for high-prestige guests.<ref name="CL" /> Connected to the private room was a room that contained sleeping pods for serious gamblers whose games lasted several days. A doorway in that room lead to a refresher that had showers for long-stay customers and a pair of sinks. The private gambling room also led to another room that contained the private bar of the bar of the Baath brothers, and behind that room was a bedroom, a refresher, and a kitchen.<ref name="CL" /> 

===Club cliques===
[[File:Outlander patrons.png|thumb|right|300px|Patrons of the Outlander Club wore garish and bizarre outfits.]]
The Outlander Club was a popular hangout for wide selection of Coruscant's glitterati,<ref name="OC" /> among them were young thrill-seekers and slumming nobles packing the dancefloor each night,<ref name="CoruscantCore" /> and lowlifes or criminals searching for gullible victims to exploit.<ref name="TVD" /> Under their innocent appearances, many of the visitors hid their bizarre and sinister secrets.<ref name="FF96" /> Some patrons came to have a good time, though most were in search of something different, like companionship,<ref name="TVD" /> whether it be permanent or temporary, buying and selling wares both legal and illicit,<ref name="OC" /> or coning people. Though for all of them, the club was a place that made the rest of the world fade away.<ref name="FF44" /> Individuals part of various cliques and social groups would meet at the club on any given night to participate in various activities, such as betting, drinking, and generally forgetting the stresses of their lives. Flirting also occurred, as the Outlander was the spot for shady meeting with prospective partners.<ref name="FF96" /> 

Catering to [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]],<ref name="FF44" /> the Outlander attracted mostly that clientele, as pan-species clubs were for the truly determined and stout of heart.<ref name="TVD" /> Although the patrons who came from far and wide were nearly exclusively humanoid,<ref name="FF44" /> the club hosted many non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] species, reflecting the club's name.<ref name="FF96" /> Attracting outrageously-dressed fashion devotees, the patron's diversity was reflected in the garish and often bizarre [[Clothing/Legends|outfits]] found in the club.<ref name="FF44" /> Individuals who were badly dressed were simply not allowed to be in the club, creating one of the best environments to spy out Coruscant's latest fashions.<ref name="FF96" />

==History==
{{Quote|Sounds like happy hour at the Outlander.|RC-1309|<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] went to the club looking for a deathstick dealer, [[Jervis Gloom]], who would help lead him to [[Komari Vosa]]. Approximately ten years later, Fett's on-and-off partner [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran inside to escape [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after she failed in her attempt to assassinate [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].

About [[1 BBY/Legends|one year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] visited the Outlander Club, where Solo shared a drink with a female [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]]. Bounty hunter [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] was also there at the time.<ref name="SWIANH">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|cardname=One Year Earlier - Han Solo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Outlander Club was originally intended to be much more club-like, with its patrons dancing. After it was deemed too distracting, the gambling and underworld dealing aspects were enhanced.

The shot of the betting area with the three large view screens was a late addition to the sequence, filmed in miniature and populated by [[Lucasfilm]] employees shot in front of a blue screen. There were only five people available, who went through different costume changes. As such, visual effects producer [[Jill Brooks]] is in the shot three times, and [[Amy Allen]] twice. These extras were also used to fill out the pick-up shots filmed in England, notably the exchange between Anakin and Obi-Wan about the bounty hunter being a changeling.

Though this may have been a simple mistake made before the name of the Outlander Club was decided upon, many [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] advertisements present in the Coruscant Entertainment District level in ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'' advertise a "Club Orb." These advertisements also exist within the Outlander Club itself. It could be an alternate name for the club (such as the case with the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]], which is also known as Chalmun's Cantina), or perhaps one of the two other bars located in the level. However, it seems unlikely that a nightclub's interior would have advertisements for another nightclub.
